page.overview:
Who is Capuletto?

Capuletto was an eccentric and wealthy Tilean merchant in the city of Tobaro. Known for his immense fortune, he lived in an ornate and imposing mansion in one of the city's wealthiest districts. Capuletto was an older man, and his reputation was marked by his intense jealousy and reclusiveness.

He was deeply protective of his young wife, Raphaella Capuletto, whom he kept hidden from the world. Rarely allowing her to leave their home, Capuletto insisted that she wear a veil whenever she ventured outside, fueling rumors and speculation among the townspeople. His peculiar behavior and the mystery surrounding his wife made Capuletto a figure of both intrigue and suspicion in Tobaro.

Capuletto's fate took a dark turn when he became the target of the assassin Liliana Falcone. Known for her preference for subtlety, Falcone orchestrated a plan that did not require her to strike the fatal blow herself. Instead, she manipulated events to damage the republican-sympathizing families of the Montagui and Capuletto. Liliana induced an unaware suitor of Raphaella, Roberto Montagui, to assassinate Capuletto in the Temple of Morr, making him believe he was acting for the sake of his lover.

This plan led to Capuletto's demise, fulfilling Liliana's contract and damaging both houses while leaving a trail of tragedy and deception in its wake.
